quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses, not reviewer conclusions. Check direct ordinary senses and actual English-label ambiguity; guards are symmetric and nontransitive. Shared topics/components alone are insufficient.
芯 safeguards core/center labels and broad heart/substance/essence English polysemy, including existing 心/身/命; these do not equate all Japanese senses or mean a location is always a material core.
新幹線 safeguards broad train/railway labels; 真空 safeguards empty wording without claiming every empty container is a vacuum.
信ずる safeguards actual believe/trust labels 思う/信用/信頼/信仰; belief and trust are not automatically identical constructions.
申請 safeguards broad request/apply labels, including noun/verb differences; not the different application-of-a-rule meaning of 適用.
人造/人工 overlap directly. 寝台/ベッド already have the exact title bed, so no redundant direct guard is needed.
診断 safeguards broad examination/test/judgment labels without equating every examination with a diagnosis. 侵入 safeguards broad enter wording without erasing its encroachment nuance.
人命 safeguards broad life labels 命/生命/生/人生/生活; different life senses remain explained rather than asserting daily living is a saved human life.
深夜 safeguards broad night labels 夜中/夜/晩; no precise shared clock boundary is asserted.
森林 safeguards forest/woods labels 森/林/山林 and conservative English wood ambiguity for 木, not a claim that Japanese 木 simply means a forest.
親類/親戚 already share the exact relative; kin title. Broader family wording 家族 has a separate declaration.
針路 safeguards course/direction/way labels 方向/コース/流れ/道; navigation is not every sense of course.
神話 safeguards broad tale/story labels 物語/話, not an inferred synonymy with every lie or superstition.
水産 safeguards fisheries/fishing labels 漁業/釣り; not an assertion that all recreational angling is the whole industry. 炊事 safeguards cooking/housework/make labels 料理/家事/作る.
心身/人文科学/酢 have no authored declarations; absence is not reviewer approval or a finding quota.
sourceAccessLimits: Twenty new articles, no reuses, cover community-list rows N2:802-N2:821; not an official modern JLPT syllabus.
Five new reciprocal N2 pairs: 線/新幹線 at セン; 造/人造 at ゾウ; 森/森林 at シン; 林/森林 at リン; 針/針路 at シン. No kanji metadata or stroke additions.
Raw fields remain verbatim and separate from teaching selections. 芯 selects JMdict senses 1-2; 真空 selects sense 1; other principal selections are sense 1.
Source raw couch, imitation, social sciences and culinary arts glosses are preserved but qualified with actual applicable lexical evidence.
JMdict and Daijisen conjugation/classification frameworks remain distinct. Rare variants do not establish relative frequency or blanket register.
Public-body extensions are explicitly sourced separately, not fabricated extra JMdict indices. No source notes prove the compiler's intended sense.
The original capture-stage plan remains unchanged; unselected broader capture content was not all read.
Actual public retrievals are retained author captures, not reviewers' own fresh retrievals. No production quiz draws, exhaustive baseline rereview or native-speaker certification.
The blind derivative omits only reviewEvidence.quizGuardRationale.
